tools.name: ce_qui_manque
tools.description: Returns the weakest axes of a published domain, with the measured finding behind each, and the buying questions no page can ever answer because the answer depends on the customer.

tools.name: secteur
tools.description: Returns the published sites of a sector, grouped by level and ordered by score alone. Scores less than 5 points apart are not separated. tools.name: devis
tools.description: Computes an exact price for a specific case (quantities, options, period) from the price list a company has itself deposited with Isoligne, and returns the calculation line by line with its source and date. tools.name: secteurs_disponibles
tools.description: Lists the sectors with at least one published company.
